text:
Iris: Quick idea — collapse 'Models' + 'Deployments' into a single 'Runtime' group to reduce top-level noise. Sketch: https://figma.redwood/runtime-group.png :sparkles:
Marcus: Yep, agree on declutter. Core requirement: deep links like /deployments/abc must still land and highlight the right child even when group is collapsed.
Neha: Routing contract suggestion: keep canonical flat paths (no hashes). On client hydrate run findNodeForPath(path) -> expand ancestors -> if initial hard load then focus the leaf link. Pseudocode: `const node = find(path); expandAncestors(node); if (isInitialLoad) node.el.focus();`
Chris: Accessibility: group toggle must be a button with aria-expanded + aria-controls. Announce "Runtime expanded" via polite live region. Respect prefers-reduced-motion for animations.
Iris: Breadcrumbs: show human-friendly labels only: Runtime > MyModel > Versions > v1.2. Avoid repeating group label twice. Also ensure breadcrumb links use canonical paths for shareability.
Marcus: Edge-case: overlapping slugs (/projects/:id vs /models/:id). Match by longest static prefix first, then sidebar order as tie-breaker. Also normalize duplicate slashes/trailing slash on server (301) to avoid duplicate breadcrumb states.
Neha: Dev note: when client routes between leaves in different groups via in-app nav, animate expand/collapse but do NOT steal focus. Only autofocus on hard loads/bookmarks. Add unit tests for aria-expanded and an integration test for deep link landing.
Chris: Microcopy: context button should say "Show Runtime" / "Hide Runtime" (helps SR users). Add skip-link "Skip to main content" for keyboard landings.
Nav-Bot: Reminder: attach updated Figma frames + annotated interactions by EOD for tomorrow's design review at 10:30am.
Iris: I'll draft the PR with the routing contract, ARIA checklist, focus behavior, and test plan. Tagging @Neha and @Chris for implementation and a11y checks.
Marcus: :thumbsup:
Neha: :eyes:
Chris: +1
